case-harmonic.title: Case 10: channel 3

config.title: Case file: channel 3
config.story: A neighbour's old TV, on channel 3 (60 to 66 MHz), gets bars across the picture when you transmit on 15 m.
evidence: Only channel 3 is affected; other channels are clean.
It only happens on 15 m: 3 × 21 MHz = 63 MHz.
There's no low-pass filter on your transmitter.
config.caption: A buzz and bars on channel 3 only, whenever you transmit on 15 m.

case-harmonic.success: One channel, one band, at a multiple of your frequency: harmonics. A low-pass filter at the transmitter removes them.

case-splatter.title: Case 11: splatter

config.title: Case file: the wide signal
config.story: Stations 3 to 5 kHz away from you on 20 m SSB say they can hear your voice, distorted.
evidence: Your mic gain is turned all the way up.
The ALC meter is pinned on voice peaks.
It's only near your frequency, not on other bands.
config.caption: Harsh, distorted speech spreading several kHz either side of your SSB signal.

case-splatter.success: Overmodulation causes splatter. Turn the mic gain down until the ALC stays in range.
